column3: Close to the Hebrew; אֵזוֹר (“loincloth”) is rendered “sash.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Perath” is rendered “the Euphrates.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a name” is rendered “renown,” and “honor” “glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wineskin” (or jar) is rendered “bottle.”
Close to the Hebrew; “smash” is rendered “dash,” and “from destroying” “but will destroy them.”
Close to the Hebrew; לְצַלְמָוֶת is rendered “the shadow of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the place of your head” is rendered “your rule.”
Close to the Hebrew; the Negev is rendered “the South.”
Close to the Hebrew; “close friends” is rendered “chieftains.”
Close to the Hebrew; “suffered violence” is rendered “made bare.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a Cushite” is rendered “the Ethiopian.”
Close to the Hebrew; “chaff” is rendered “stubble.”
Close to the Hebrew; “after when yet” is rendered “Will you still not be made clean?”
